lines.4: Huh? I'd only just managed to fall asleep.
lines.6: Then I noticed something clinging to me.
lines.13: I glanced over at Konoe's futon.
lines.14: Her futon was a complete mess.
lines.16: I vaguely remembered hearing something like that.
lines.17: She'd crossed the border herself, damn it.
lines.18: And she was clinging to me with all her might.
lines.20: 「Ugh... Don't rub your face against me in your sleep.」
lines.21: I knew how this went. Konoe would suddenly wake up, and then I'd get attacked for no good reason.
lines.25: I rolled Konoe over and over.
lines.26: She stopped rolling right on her futon.
lines.28: 「All right. Nice control, if I do say so myself.」
lines.30: I moved the futons nearly six meters apart.
lines.32: I crawled back into my futon.
